relation: one central hub maintains one direct link to each of five independent spokes, distributes one shared signal outward, and receives one acknowledgement back from every spoke without any spoke-to-spoke relay

stageEvents.observable: the single coordinating hub is the dominant object before any link is active
five independent spokes become readable around the fixed hub with no spoke-to-spoke edge
one shared signal travels from the hub along every direct spoke link
each spoke returns one acknowledgement directly to the same hub
all five links are confirmed while the star topology and absence of peer relay remain visible
the completed five-of-five direct-link proof holds as a readable handoff state

limits: exactly one hub and five independent spokes
each spoke has exactly one direct edge to the hub and no edge to another spoke
one shared outbound signal reaches every spoke before acknowledgements are collected
each spoke returns one acknowledgement directly along its own hub link
the resolved result appears only after all five acknowledgements are present
radial placement expresses direct central connection only and does not imply hierarchy, order, distance, coverage radius, or peer-to-peer routing
